protocols.name: Profiler
protocols.purpose: Build a bounded working map of how this particular recipient approaches a decision, using their supplied words, actions and stated priorities.

protocols.name: Profiler Plus
protocols.purpose: Translate an honest proposal into the frame this recipient can understand and evaluate, without changing its facts or conditions.

protocols.name: Dopamine Hooks
protocols.purpose: Build a connected movement of attention through the whole text, with meaningful answers and useful transitions.

protocols.name: Reverse
protocols.purpose: Walk through the material as its recipient could read it, then place supported answers where consequential questions arise.

protocols.name: Rail
protocols.purpose: Prepare the usable execution kit, rather than a description of work the recipient still has to organize.
